claim: The blue jug can hold at least 1.5 liters.
yes: I poured a full 1.5 liters of water into the empty blue jug. It came right to the brim and stayed there.
no: The empty blue jug was already full after I poured in 1.4 liters.
uncertain: There’s a liter of lemonade in the blue jug, with some room left at the top.

claim: The glass pitcher holds more than 750 mL.
yes: There’s 800 mL of cold tea in the glass pitcher right now.
no: Filled all the way to the lip, the glass pitcher holds exactly 750 mL.
uncertain: I poured 750 mL of tea into the empty glass pitcher. It all fit, but I didn’t check the level.

claim: The soup pot has a total capacity of less than 3 liters.
yes: We ladled everything out of the brimful soup pot and measured it. There were 2.8 liters altogether.
no: The soup pot has 3 liters of stock in it, and I can still stir without spilling any.
uncertain: Dinner left us with 2 liters of broth in the soup pot. I could see bare metal above the broth.

claim: The bedside carafe holds at most 600 mL.
yes: The instructions give the bedside carafe’s capacity as exactly 600 mL when filled to the brim.
no: I emptied 650 mL of water into the bedside carafe last night, and all of it stayed inside.
uncertain: I stopped filling the bedside carafe at the 500 mL mark so it would be easier to carry upstairs.

claim: The insulated flask has a total capacity of exactly 1 liter.
yes: I measured the water it took to fill the empty insulated flask to the brim. It took exactly 1,000 mL.
no: I poured a full liter into the empty insulated flask and there was still room for another splash.
uncertain: I poured 400 mL from the insulated flask into my mug and measured the remaining 600 mL. I hadn’t checked how full the flask was before I poured.

claim: The watering can can hold at least 2 liters.
yes: After I put 1.25 liters of water in the empty watering can, my daughter tipped in another 750 mL. None spilled or drained out.
no: I started with an empty watering can and a measured 2 liters of water. When the can was brimful, I still had 100 mL left to pour.
uncertain: I put 1.8 liters in the empty watering can and carried it to the windowsill. There was room for a little more.
